source_text: –22 Τῆς αἱμορροούσης αἰσθόμενος ὁ Χριστὸς οὐκ ἀπηξίωσεν αὐτήν, ἀλλ' ἐθεράπευσε καὶ θυγατέρα ἐκάλεσεν ὡς πιστήν, ἅμα δὲ καὶ δει κνύων, ὅτι οὐκ ἔστι παρὰ τῷ θεῷ ἀκάθαρτος ὁ ἔχων νόσον ἀκούσιον.
pass_a_gloss: Of the hemorrhage-suffering having-perceived the Christ not he-deemed-unworthy her, but he-healed and daughter he-called as faithful, together but also showing, that not is beside the God unclean the having disease involuntary.
pass_b_english: Perceiving the woman with the hemorrhage, Christ did not deem her unworthy, but healed her and called her daughter as one faithful — and at the same time showing that with God no one who has an involuntary disease is unclean.
